us-sec-war.description: Ran the Army. The Department of War was split by the National Security Act of 1947 into the Department of the Army and the Department of the Air Force under the new National Military Establishment (renamed Department of Defense in 1949).

us-sec-air-force.description: The Air Force became a separate service under the National Security Act of 1947.
